ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 55:45 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe presents a dominant white field with black marginal banding and several discrete dark circular blobs in the mid-distal region. Right lobe displays a dominant black field with white mottling concentrated near the median notch and lower trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a deep pixel-depth relative to the lobe width, forming a sharp interior angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration characterized by multiple peaks and valleys (3-8 pixels in amplitude) along the entire visible trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the left lobe leading to a tapered, slightly upward-curved tip; right lobe trajectory is partially obscured by water spray but suggests a similar convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated cluster of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized on the far outer margin of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, distinct, near-vertical dark linear disruption (rake mark) cutting through the white pigmentation on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical linear scar on the right lobe; significant white calcified clusters (barnacles) on the right-most peripheral edge.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific triad of dark focal spots located in the center-left white pigmentation field.
